# About Felipe Martignon Lizarralde

Felipe Martignon Lizarralde is a Colombian professional based in Valencia, Spain, open to
relocating within Spain for the right role. He has 5+ years of client-facing experience
across fintech, crypto, and SaaS, with a growing specialization in AI engineering. Contact:
martignon@gmail.com, linkedin.com/in/fmartignon.

## Profile summary

Client-facing operations professional with 5+ years across SaaS, FinTech, and crypto,
managing account security, onboarding, and complex customer casework at volume. Skilled at
diagnosing root causes from operational data, coordinating cross-functional resolution with
Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance, and keeping service quality high under
strict SLAs. Completed an AI Engineering Bootcamp (Python, SQL, Machine Learning, APIs,
LLMs, automation) in August 2026, on top of a Google Data Analytics Professional
Certificate and a Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate. Bilingual in Spanish
(native) and English (near-native, 5 years living and studying in the USA), with
intermediate French (B1/B2).

## Current employment status: yes, Felipe is currently employed

As of now, Felipe is currently employed as a **Project Tutor, Ironhack AI Engineering
Bootcamp** — Remote, since September 2026 (contract through November 9, 2026). His prior
role at Kraken ended in June 2026, so there was a short gap (about three months) between
Kraken and starting this tutoring contract, during which he was job-searching and
completing the AI Engineering bootcamp himself. He is actively looking for his next
full-time role in Customer Success, Client Operations, or Support once this short-term
tutoring contract wraps up.
- Leads a class of 19 international students entirely in English, guiding them through
  Python, SQL, APIs, machine learning, and LLM-based projects.
- Completed the same bootcamp himself in August 2026 before moving into the tutoring role,
  giving him both the practitioner and the teaching perspective on the material.

## What Felipe is looking for

Felipe is targeting Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Implementation, and Client
Operations roles, ideally at fintech, crypto, compliance tech, cybersecurity, or AI
companies. He's based in Valencia, Spain, and open to relocating to Barcelona, Madrid,
Bilbao, or Tenerife within Spain.

## What makes Felipe's background distinctive

The combination of hands-on crypto-exchange account security experience, direct KYC and
compliance exposure, active AI/LLM engineering skills from completing and now teaching an
AI Engineering bootcamp, and real teaching experience leading an international class is an
unusual mix. It positions him well for roles that sit at the intersection of client
operations and the AI/compliance-tech space — for example, customer-facing roles at AI
companies, or trust-and-safety / compliance-adjacent roles at fintech and crypto firms.

## Honest gaps

Felipe is upfront about what he doesn't yet have: no multi-year B2B SaaS tenure, no
quota-carrying sales or deal-closing experience, no experience running QBRs, and no formal
ownership of renewals or expansion revenue. His people-management experience (recruitment,
training, and performance oversight at FM Función Mejorar, 2015-2019) was within his own
small business rather than inside a larger corporate structure, so it's real but limited in
scale. He also hasn't used Salesforce, HubSpot, Power BI, or SAP professionally yet, though
he picks up new tools quickly (demonstrated by the AI Engineering bootcamp).

# Sobre Felipe Martignon Lizarralde

Felipe Martignon Lizarralde es un profesional colombiano afincado en Valencia, España,
abierto a reubicarse dentro de España por el puesto adecuado. Tiene más de 5 años de
experiencia de cara al cliente en fintech, crypto y SaaS, y se está especializando cada vez
más en ingeniería de IA. Contacto: martignon@gmail.com, linkedin.com/in/fmartignon.

## Resumen del perfil

Profesional de operaciones de cara al cliente con más de 5 años de experiencia en SaaS,
FinTech y crypto, gestionando seguridad de cuentas, onboarding y casuística compleja de
clientes con alto volumen. Hábil en diagnosticar causas raíz a partir de datos operativos,
coordinar resoluciones multidisciplinares con Producto, Ingeniería, Operaciones y
Cumplimiento, y mantener una calidad de servicio alta bajo SLAs estrictos. Completó un
Bootcamp de Ingeniería de IA (Python, SQL, Machine Learning, APIs, LLMs, automatización) en
agosto de 2026, además de un Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate y un Google
Cybersecurity Professional Certificate. Bilingüe en español (nativo) e inglés (nivel casi
nativo, 5 años viviendo y estudiando en EE. UU.), con francés intermedio (B1/B2).

## Situación laboral actual: sí, Felipe está empleado actualmente

Actualmente, Felipe está empleado como **Project Tutor, Ironhack AI Engineering
Bootcamp** — Remoto, desde septiembre de 2026 (contrato hasta el 9 de noviembre de 2026).
Su puesto anterior en Kraken terminó en junio de 2026, por lo que hubo un pequeño espacio
(unos tres meses) entre Kraken y el inicio de este contrato de tutoría, durante el cual
estuvo buscando empleo y completando el bootcamp de Ingeniería de IA. Está buscando
activamente su próximo puesto a tiempo completo en Customer Success, Operaciones de Cliente
o Soporte, una vez termine este contrato temporal de tutoría.
- Lidera una clase de 19 estudiantes internacionales íntegramente en inglés, guiándolos en
  proyectos de Python, SQL, APIs, machine learning y LLMs.
- Completó el mismo bootcamp en agosto de 2026 antes de pasar al rol de tutor, lo que le da
  tanto la perspectiva de practicante como la de docente sobre el contenido.

poco habitual. Lo posiciona bien para roles en la intersección entre operaciones de
cliente y el espacio de IA/compliance tech — por ejemplo, roles de cara al cliente en
empresas de IA, o roles de trust & safety / adyacentes a compliance en fintech y crypto.
